title: Trades And Treasures
description: This project adds alot of new things, New mobs, New blocks, New tools, New armor, New minerals, New structures, New ways of trading, Treasures, And ALOT more!
body:
Trades & Treasures is a new mod that brings alot of new building blocks and gear into the game, And a goblin hoarder.

You can explore in the wild and you may find the Warm Plains biome, Where a new tree type can be harvested named Amberwood, If you're lucky, You may find a Bamboo Village in this biome.

That's not all, I also added a new cave biome called Creamstone Caverns, Where you can find all types of ores including the vanilla ones, With 5 new ore types, [Jade, Sunstone, Deep Amber, Moon Opal and Black Pearl], Which you can also use to craft cool gear like Armor, Swords, Tools!

There's also this new mob called a Goblin Hoarder, It will drop useful loot upon death, Sometimes a chest if lucky!
